column7: 2026-11-05: On the acme branch, the sort_keys option must default to ON (upstream/main will default off). Reason: Acme's tooling calls plain dumps() and we can't change their call sites. Plan: add sort_keys on main first, then bring it over here with the flipped default. Cause of the churn: gen_table_chunks emits plain values before sub-tables and an array of tables flips between inline and [[...]] by width, so key order shifts between drops.

2026-11-05: sort_keys added to dump/dumps (keyword-only, default False so default output is unchanged); sorts at every level incl. inline tables via sorted_items() in _writer.py. AoT element order is preserved, only keys are sorted.

2026-11-05: sort_keys cherry-picked from main (5514554) and default flipped to True in dump/dumps/Context. Existing formatting tests (test_style, test_types::test_decimal) pin sort_keys=False because they assert insertion-order output. Expect conflicts/default mismatch if merging with main.
